posts.text:
trump’s ‘project freedom’
sounds decisive.
in practice?
no escorts. no reopening.
just a softer approach to a hard problem.
@gzeromedia

Video

project freedom update:
strait of hormuz remains closed

trump's ‘project freedom’
meant reopening shipping lanes.
what it became:
mapping mines, avoiding escalation, and asking others to help.
@gzeromedia

Video

a strange game, uno. 
the only winning move is not to play.

iranians willing to continue to use force to keep strait closed. 

today showing readiness to return to war and impose new costs if current status quo continues.
i think it’s hard when people conflate analysis with what they want.
i won’t interview tucker carlson or appear on his show. too many instances of disinformation and bad faith to merit platforming in my view.

smells like mean spirit


Elizabeth Warren (@ewarren)

The Big Four airlines (American, Delta, Southwest, United) control 75% of the U.S. market.

Fewer choices = higher prices for you.
Community note: In 2024, Senator Warren supported the Biden Administration’s DOJ suing to prevent the merger between JetBlue and Spirit, fearing “fewer flights and higher fares”. Now Spirit shutdown, resulting in fewer flights and less competition.

x.com/senwarren/stat…



— https://nitter.net/ewarren/status/204

any strategic purpose of withdrawing 5,000 us troops from germany? 

no. trump feeling personally insulted by the german chancellor is the policy priority.
loving the new banksy in london

reflecting with @trevornoah on the randomness of being born american. catholic. and a scorpio.

and the very deliberate choice to be a new yorker.

Video

king charles' visit was by far the most deft diplomacy that we've seen from a leader in trump's second term.

not sure it's something we should get used to, but a win nonetheless.

9% say it weakens american society

83% of americans say treating people of all backgrounds equally is central to being american.

82% say believing in freedom, justice and equality. 

higher percentages response to any other questions 

voting in elections: 70%
believing in god: 49%
being born in us: 36%

yes. china is leading the world in electrification, batteries, solar, wind and nuclear…while the united states has decided to only go all in on oil and gas. 

as the world’s superpower why can’t we do both?
